Here is what the repo actually defines for an encounter goal of **140**.

## Where **140** comes from (encounter goal)

**Data file — this is the source of `140`.**

`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\data\goals\goal_payout_threshold.tres`

```6:9:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\data\goals\goal_payout_threshold.tres
id = &"goal_payout_threshold"
display_text = "Reach payout target"
target_payout = 140
```

Classification: **`.tres` resource property** on `GoalPayoutThreshold`. It overrides whatever the script’s `@export` default is when this resource is loaded.

---

## How that ties to the encounter

**Encounter resource** loads that goal:

`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\data\encounters\encounter_payout.tres`

```3:10:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\data\encounters\encounter_payout.tres
[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://combat/scripts/encounter.gd" id="1_script"]
[ext_resource type="Resource" path="res://combat/data/goals/goal_payout_threshold.tres" id="2_goal"]

[resource]
script = ExtResource("1_script")
id = &"encounter_payout"
goal = ExtResource("2_goal")
spin_budget = 8
```

**Scene** uses that encounter:

`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\combat_root.tscn` — `encounter_def` is `ExtResource("11_encounter")` pointing at `res://combat/data/encounters/encounter_payout.tres` (confirmed by grep; full snippet not re-read here).

---

## Script default (not 140)

The goal type’s **GDScript default** is **100**, not 140:

`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\goal_payout_threshold.gd`

```4:5:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\goal_payout_threshold.gd
@export var target_payout: int = 100
```

Classification: **exported variable default** — only applies when the property is not set on the resource/instance.

---

## Other “140” hits (not this encounter goal)

Repo-wide grep finds **`140`** in places like `project.godot` viewport width **1400**, `.tscn` internal IDs, CSS/`moon_princess` bundles — none of those define payout encounter goal **140**. Under `AXEL\axel_project`, the only `target_payout = …` assignment is in **`goal_payout_threshold.tres`**.

---

## Summary

| Location | Role |
|---------|------|
| `...\combat\data\goals\goal_payout_threshold.tres` | **`target_payout = 140`** — actual goal value for this resource |
| `...\combat\data\encounters\encounter_payout.tres` | Encounter uses that goal resource |
| `...\combat\scenes\combat_root.tscn` | Uses `encounter_payout.tres` |
| `...\combat\scripts\goal_payout_threshold.gd` | Default **100**; 140 is **not** from this default |

So the encounter goal **140** is a **data file (`.tres`) value**, not a hardcoded literal in GDScript for this flow, and not the script’s `@export` default.
